required_abstract_decision_display_rule: When a text turn explains or compares subtype, layout grammar, visual style, density, metaphor, modeling pattern, candidate scheme differences, or final content architecture, display a matching saved atlas/reference or non-target concept/modeling example image with Markdown syntax; if missing, record concept_example_required/status/role/trigger_reason and repair action.
